It doesn't address the whole issue so can we go with "Addresses part of openbmc/bmcweb#323."

I guess ... unfortunately "addresses part of" doesn't make a nice link in github back to the commit.

https://docs.github.com/en/issues/tracking-your-work-with-issues/using-issues/linking-a-pull-request-to-an-issue

I would still suggest "fixes [part of]" or "resolves [part of]" since that is the words that GH natively supports.
Using one of the keywords would close the issue when this commit is merged, so we could open a new issue for the remaining 2 wrap files.
Lets just get this on master.  If the issue closes, we can reopen.
